name: Restriction on Stock Location
description:
The Stock Location Restriction module restricts users to specific warehouse locations in Odoo’s Inventory app. With this app, administrators can assign which users or user groups can view, select, or process operations in specific stock locations—such as internal, customer, vendor, or transit locations.

This is ideal for multi-warehouse setups, branch-level permissions, or restricted operational zones, and helps maintain inventory security and clean process flows.
